---
title:Gene-set enrichment of ERAP2 knockdown in astrocytes
output:pdf_document
---

### Main questions

We set out to understand the role of ERAP2 in ALS. The main questions that have been defined until now are,

- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA in control lines?
- What is the effect between control and ALS lines? 
- What is the effect of ERAP2 siRNA on ALS lines? 



### 1.0 Package requirements

- change to current working directory `/camp/lab/luscomben/home/users/palk/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis`.

```{r}

setwd("/camp/lab/luscomben/home/users/palk/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/analysis")

```


- Include required packages and functions

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

require("stringr")
require("DESeq2")
require("ggplot2")
require("RcolorBrewer")
require("enrichR")
require("stringr")
source("src/enrichR_plots.R")

```

- Set paths

```{r}

analysis_path <- "02-differential-expression-profiling"
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "rdata_files")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "plots")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "input_files")
output_dir <- file.path(analysis_path, "output_files")

```


- Load the candidate gene selection from previous steps


```{r}

candidate_genes_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-significantly-affected-genes-by-kd-in-als-vs-control.rds"))

```

### 1.0 Gene set enrichment using enrichR GO molecular function


- Perform gene set enrichment for selected genes df ALS vs Control 

```{r}

all_original_enrichment_df <- make_enrichR_df(candidate_genes_df, lfc_col = "logfc", db = "GO_Molecular_Function_2021")
pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "06-go-molecular-function-gene-set-enrichment-profiles-als_vs_control_selected_genes.pdf"))
plotEnrich(all_original_enrichment_df[all_original_enrichment_df$direction == "down",], showTerms = 30, numChar = 50, y = "Ratio", orderBy = "Ratio", title = paste("GO Molecular Function GSEA downregulated"))
plotEnrich(all_original_enrichment_df[all_original_enrichment_df$direction == "up",], showTerms = 30, numChar = 50, y = "Ratio", orderBy = "Ratio", title = paste("GO Molecular Function GSEA upregulated"))
dev.off()


```

- Perform gene set enrichment for selected genes df ERAP2 KD

```{r}

kd_enrichment_df <- make_enrichR_df(candidate_genes_df, lfc_col = "kd_effect_lfc", db = "GO_Molecular_Function_2021")

pdf(file = file.path(plot_dir, "06-go-molecular-function-gene-set-enrichment-profiles-KD-effect-als_vs_control_selected_genes.pdf"))

plotEnrich(kd_enrichment_df[kd_enrichment_df$direction == "down",], showTerms = 30, numChar = 50, y = "Ratio", orderBy = "Ratio", title = paste("GO Molecular Function GSEA downregulated"))

plotEnrich(kd_enrichment_df[kd_enrichment_df$direction == "up",], showTerms = 30, numChar = 50, y = "Ratio", orderBy = "Ratio", title = paste("GO Molecular Function GSEA upregulated"))

dev.off()

```

- Make two sample gene-set enrichment plots


```{r}


both_sample_enrichment_df <- make_two_sample_enrichR_df(candidate_genes_df, lfc_col_1 = "logfc", lfc_col_2 = "kd_effect_lfc", groups = c("ALS vs Control", "ERAP2 KD"), reference_group = "ALS vs Control",
        ref_group_gene_ratio_threshold = 0.1, db = "GO_Molecular_Function_2021")

the_plot <- ggplot(both_sample_enrichment_df, aes(x = Term, y = gene_ratio))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_col(aes(fill = group), colour = "#000000", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9))
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = "dashed", colour = "#FF0000")
the_plot <- the_plot + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, lty = "dashed", colour = "#FF0000")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_x_discrete("molecular function terms")
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_y_continuous("gene ratio")
the_plot <- the_plot + theme_bw()
the_plot <- the_plot + scale_fill_brewer("groups", palette = "Set1")
the_plot <- the_plot + theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 1, angle = 90),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed", size = 0.2))
ggsave(the_plot, file = file.path(plot_dir, "07-molecular-function-terms-affected-by-kd.pdf"), height = 7, width = 7)


```
